purpose: Test whether the exact V83 terminal-OCS/nonterminal-FaaSRank initializer can retain its confirmed throughput while a dual routed-expert and exact-OCS coordination certificate rejects Nash moves that preserve modeled welfare but degrade workflow-closing efficiency.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause_hypothesis: The V83 initializer is the strongest confirmed throughput anchor, but its coordination guard permits a paper-welfare-improving proposal whenever only the routed-expert score is nonworse. Exact OCS is the frozen best-QPR baseline and represents the workflow-closing affinity used by terminal players, so a proposal that worsens the complete exact-OCS score can preserve routed score and paper welfare while degrading the latency-cost product. V85 demonstrated that adding a second OCS certificate is implementable, but its separate alternative initializer introduced 1060 accepted substitutions and moved both metrics away from V83. V86 therefore removes every V85 initializer substitution and tests only the missing OCS coordination certificate on the exact V83 anchor.
diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.first_principles_qpr_mechanism: For terminal functions, the exact OCS score ranks current-demand warm-affinity and load conditions directly available before placement. Requiring the complete proposal not to worsen that score prevents a coordinated move from sacrificing the workflow-closing objective while the independent routed score protects throughput-bearing nonterminal placements.

execution_order: Commit this V86 plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E680-E709 artifact.

Implement only the V86 profile and required observability by combining the exact V83 initializer with the already-defined dual complete-score guard; do not change baselines, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload or environment weights.
Pass focused exact-anchor and three-certificate tests plus all sche_nash tests, rustfmt, cargo check and an isolated release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E680-E689 candidate-only screen inputs, capture each base tape once, derive one scale5 tape per seed and build ten state-matched references.
Execute exactly ten candidate runs strictly serially without opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require ten attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact frozen runtime identity and a result-free audit before simultaneous reveal.
Require all three candidate arithmetic means to strictly exceed their frozen quality floors; report one-sample BCa intervals without changing the screen gate.
If and only if all three screen gates pass, commit an unchanged-candidate confirmation authorization before generating E690-E709.

Run only twenty unchanged NSESche confirmation samples, not baselines. Require all three confirmation means and all three one-sample BCa lower bounds to exceed the same frozen quality floors before freezing the 100-node point.
If any screen or confirmation gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on those seeds and close the V86 family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across the complete candidate cohort.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all seeds.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three frozen quality floors; ties fail.
analysis.screen_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-fixed-floor one-sample BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean screen gate.
analysis.confirmation_gate: For all three metrics, both the E690-E709 arithmetic mean and the one-sample candidate-minus-fixed-floor BCa 95% lower bound must be strictly greater than the frozen floor/zero; ties fail.
analysis.publication_use: A confirmed result becomes the NSESche homogeneous 100-node low-load scale5 resource-scaling point and is combined with the compatible frozen 20-node NSESche point; no 100-node baseline curve is required.
analysis.failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on revealed seeds, generate no reserved inputs after a screen failure and close V86.
